notes.title: Quick Update v.0.1.3!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Pioneers! 

We’re back for another update! 

Some of you may have seen the “Long Connector” in the last update…and now it’s officially in the game. We can’t wait to see what players build with this new blueprint. We also made grabbing items a bit easier overall. 
[/p][p]There are also some other minor updates, so check the patch notes below for the full list. As always, we’d love to hear [url="https://discord.gg/a6Kq86eTFN"]from you on our Discord[/url]. Thanks to everyone who has been reporting issues to [url="https://surviving-mars-pioneer-public.feedbear.com/boards/bug-reports"]the Feedbear[/url] as it has really helped us improve Surviving Mars: Pioneer even more![/p][p]
[/p][p]And lastly, the Gleam Giveaway is almost at its end, so make sure to check out the Gleam page for last minute entries to win exclusive merchandise. 
[url="https://gleam.io/sF5OZ/surviving-mars-pioneer-giveaway" style="button"]Enter Here[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/f6f2ffba0104c9d9c22f9acdeccc5e7aa2a840de.png"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Changelog for 0.1.3 (1091)

[/b][/p][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][p]- Added the long connector
[b]Changes[/b][/p][p]- Made grabbing items easier
- Improved hints for the storeroom puzzle[/p][p]- Added a system to respawn unreachable dropped on death backpacks, they now spawn by you when entering an area with any bugged backpacks[/p][p]- Fixed the player collider allowing you to pass through things[/p][p]- Updated the hand collision with the blueprint terminal[/p][p]- Fixed the cannot save Version### bug[/p][p]- Adjusted the placement of the watch when playing with left hand mode[/p][p]- Fixed visual issues with connectors and airlocks[/p][p]- Fixed the intro restarting when entering the landing pod[/p][p]- Added missing item icons[/p][p]- Fixed being unable to remove buildings on old corrupted save files[/p][p]- Removed unused UI on the hoverbike[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: One Small Tap -- More VR Interactions, Difficulty Sliders and More!
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1]Hey Pioneers![/h1][p][/p][p]We have a massive patch today, dubbed the[b] “One Small Tap” update![/b] We’ve been reading all of your reviews, and watching your streams to see what everyone wants from Surviving Mars: Pioneer. We are thrilled with the overall positive reception, but we want to make SMP even better as we gear up for the 1.0 release. Today’s update addresses some of the feedback we’ve received while fixing a bunch of minor bugs.[/p][p][/p][h1]Win some Merch![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/8077d502422713b37bcd8268aed0f0148aa37e8e.png"][/img]
We are hosting a Gleam Giveaway to offer a chance to win some exclusive limited edition merchandise! Win a t-shirt featuring the iconic poster, or a hat. Follow the Gleam Page for more ways to enter. For extra entries enter “RocketMan” as a secret code! 
[/p][p][url="https://gleam.io/sF5OZ/surviving-mars-pioneer-giveaway" style="button" buttoncolor="#977b17"]Enter to Win Prizes Here![/url][/p][p][/p][h1]Touch and More VR Interactions
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/33c7acffb58974d946ea35c143e452ee130a6c03.png"][/img][/h1][p]One of the biggest points of feedback that we’ve received was that players wanted to feel even more immersed in Surviving Mars: Pioneer! [b]We have implemented a number of tweaks and improvements to help you feel even more at home with your new home away from home. [/b]Most screens can now be touched, and your backpack can be grabbed from behind. If you want to quickly drop loot into your inventory, just throw it over your shoulder![/p][p][/p][h1] New Difficulty Slider[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/c1bc89de7bec5945ea61cbcfd2f3d1bc04d425ca.png"][/img]  [/p][p]A big debate within the community was the difficulty of Surviving Mars: Pioneer. Some players felt the game was [i]too easy[/i] while others had trouble [i]surviving[/i] their first couple of nights. [b]We’ve decided to give players more control over their experience. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are introducing new difficulty sliders into the game, which will allow players to fine tune their experience. Three presets are available – [b]Story, Pioneer [/b]and [b]Survival[/b]. This can be done when starting a new game, or during your game at any time. You can also adjust the rate that your oxygen and hunger depletes, how often storms appear, how quickly resources regenerate and decide if you want to drop your items on death. Please let us know what you think of this [url="https://discord.gg/a6Kq86eTFN"]new feature in our Discord[/url] [/p][p]
[/p][h1]Bug Reporting is Made Easier[/h1][p]There is now a way to report bugs directly in the game! If you find something that causes an issue, please pause the game and use the in-game reporting feature to let us know. A reference number will be provided on the screen.[b] If you have additional information you would like to share with us, please submit a Feedbear post.
[/b][url="https://surviving-mars-pioneer-public.feedbear.com/boards/bug-reports" style="button"]Post Feedback and Bugs Here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also done a pass on the main menu screen to help showcase the latest version number. Now all versions of the game are using a unified version number which can help make reporting even easier![/p][p][/p][p]Here is everything else that is included in the update:[/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/95f79378f560a89a58bebe48d4287bcd463d7103.png"][/img]  

🛠️ v0.1.2 “One Small Tap” Patch Notes
[/h1][h3]🌟 New & Improved[/h3][p]
- New Difficulty options (can be adjusted in game)[/p][p]- Implemented physical (range) grabbing for objects[/p][p]- Inventory can now be grabbed from over the shoulder[/p][p]- Screens can now be touched[/p][p]- Items can be dropped into backpack[/p][p]- Ray only shows when pointing at something selectable[/p][p]- New UI follow logic for head movement[/p][p]- Adjusted construction gesture menu[/p][p]- Changed “Help” to “Tips” in main menu[/p][p]- New skyboxes in rotation[/p][p]- Wind and solar can now connect directly to transformers[/p][p]- Added move speed multiplier option[/p][p]- Added player voice selection option[/p][p]- Added visible version numbers to main menu and pause menu[/p][p]- Updated main menu and pause menu design[/p][p]- Airlock textures have been updated
[/p][h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][p]- Updated connection visuals[/p][p]- Weather wall display fixed[/p][p]- Fixed blueprint terminal colliders[/p][p]- Unified inner airlock door design[/p][p]- Fixed vehicles flipping when changing scenes[/p][p]- Fixed wall screen portraits not being scannable[/p][p]- Fixed contracts leaking (also patches save files)[/p][p]- Fixed "unknown ore" contract bug that broke saving[/p][p]- Disabled autosave in dynamic scenes to improve stability[/p][p]- Fixed interaction support for fridge upper row[/p][p]- Fixed connectors not conducting power[/p][p]- Fixed construction tool selection not always updating correctly[/p][p]- Wall - Straight blueprint now available[/p][p]

[/p][h3]⚠️ Known Issues[/h3][p][/p][p]- The right screen on the hoverbike is not displaying correctly
[/p][p]As always, we really appreciate the community's support. We’ll be sharing more information about our plans for 1.0 in the coming weeks. Until then, please continue to sound off in the Discord with your thoughts and feedback![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Fixes for Save Files, Inventory and More!
notes.content:
Hey Pioneers!

We are just pushing out an updated build today. This should make things more stable. In particular, the team has been working on addressing the inventory issues that have popped up, and some bugs that caused save files to be corrupted. If you are experiencing any issues please let us [url=https://discord.gg/a6Kq86eTFN]know on our Discord[/url]. 

Special thanks to 8a22a who shared his home away from home with us. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/d431e7e6cbd17264ae633b08248b0b253c09929c.png[/img]
# Build 1052 // May 22nd, 2025
- Made changes to inventory/socket
- Fix for save files corrupting
- Fix for darkness in Caves on Steam
- Fix being able to get progression locked before launch pad
- Removed deprecated storage container found in Mount Nyx
- Updated the rover visuals
- Fixed exiting vehicles
- Fixed wall colliders in bathrooms
- Fixed radiation protection upgrade
- Fixed planter box crafting
- Fixed colliders on vehicle ramps in New Amsterdam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/e53e256d03d98097256b8b2e93529ece963043b2.png[/img]

We haven't been just working on bug fixes, we are also making progress on new content / reworks. Stand by for more information!

notes.title: More Updates Fixes for Inventory, Flashlights and More!
notes.content:
Hey Pioneers two more patches have been released! These bug fixes have been coming in so fast that we decided to combine two updates into one post.

Reminder to join [url=https://discord.gg/a6Kq86eTFN]our Discord[/url] as we'll be talking more about the future of SMP with the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/3784cd6e0f25f20f943928a1597f1bbc7f02e580.png[/img]
Newest image comes from Hostile in the SMP Discord! It looks like such a cozy home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/9297aca644c975c8f785822d2d8b6bec753f71d9.png[/img]

[h1]Build 1036 // May 16th, 2025[/h1]

- Fixed volume settings not being applied on game start
- Fixed ambient effect volume not being affected by effects volume
- Added an "Interface Volume" slider to sound settings
- Fixed locker animation so that it is actually open when re-entering after a scene transition
- Fixed an issue where structures (habitats, power connectors, etc.) could end in a limbo state
- Fixed unlock descriptions on a couple of areas
- Fixed a very high visual scene exit in one of the areas, effectively blocking access
- Fixed lightning storms also striking in indoor scenes
- Fixed laptop (game item) rotating around the wrong axis
- Fixed floating rocks in Mount Erebus
- Fixed unintentional visual mesh clipping in New Amsterdam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/a159efdef717e9288609af94aa8678125d488471.png[/img]

[h1]Build 1041 // May 16th, 2025[/h1]

- Fixed all inventory/container issues
- Improved flashlight brightness in caves
- Player is no longer able to eat with helmet on
- Removed buying the RTG blueprint
- Fixed gap in Widowspan cave
- Added missing items to furniture crafter
- Fixed jetpack being constantly active on Virtual Desktop
- Fixed holes in Mount Nyx cave
- Fixed Envas not saving progress

notes.title: Quick Save, Stability and More!
notes.content:
[h1][Incoming Transmission from Mission Control] [/h1]

We dropped two patches for Surviving Mars: Pioneer.
Special shout out to the players who joined our Discord and are sharing their feedback directly with us. It's really making a difference in helping Surviving Mars: Pioneer become an even better game during its Early Access Period. 

Come join the fun [url=https://discord.gg/a6Kq86eTFN]on our Discord[/url]!

Deathliger stopped by to show off their growing base!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/241c38d102f6101339bd597c8e098ee51c9d54bb.png[/img]

[h1]Patch (Build 1009), May 9th, 2025[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/8f3479fc8c1ac1387e1c85027d218ae7d33d15b4.png[/img]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
- Added auto-save functionality
- Added company logos to game loader with animations
- Fixed save functionality in dynamic areas to prevent crashes

[h3]🖥️ UI Improvements[/h3]
- Fixed splash screen progress indicator
- Added percentage display on planter box
- Updated main menu and various interface screens
- Updated cockpit screens with new designs
- Improved scanning minigame functionality
- Added dark blue gradient bar for better item cost text visibility
- Added spacing between requirements on contract details UI

[h3]🔊 Audio Enhancements[/h3]
- Added splash screen audio
- Added recycler audio effects
- Polished audio for launch platform

[h3]⚖️ Gameplay Balance & Content[/h3]
- Updated strain grow times for better progression
- Balanced jetpack parameters:
- Recharge fuel delay
- Fuel rate
- Start fuel
- Zero fuel delay
- Updated recipe requirements for:
- Solar Panel
- Magnesium Alloy
- Made static image display disks non-researchable

[h3]🗺️ Area Improvements[/h3]
- Updated encounter areas with better descriptions and content
- Renamed multiple areas with more thematic names:

[h3]🌐 World Building[/h3]
- Added detailed descriptions for areas and resources
- Updated contract descriptions for crafting components
- Wrote detailed claim descriptions for various objectives
- Enhanced journal entries to match updated objectives

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed potential crash in main menu news
- Fixed threading issue
- Fixed entity cube light level
- Added delay to door interactions
- Fixed floating bed in start sequence
- Fixed floating control panel in menu

[h1]Build 1030, May 12th, 2025[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/60952a271e95d35aa1648f2ab292b5e5d15eb2f4.png[/img]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
- Removed Electronic Component as a requirement to craft Chemistry Station, Planter Box, Recycler and Tech Station
- Tweaked auto save
- Minor bug fixes
- Disabled sitting/standing auto detection

Lastly, we are collecting bug reports and [url=https://surviving-mars-pioneer-public.feedbear.com/roadmap]suggestions on Feedbear[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537233/f540405c26ae68095aae3bfb11e21ab7a2078037.png[/img]
We will be prioritizing feedback with updates, so let us know what you want to see!

See you soon, space cowboy!
